svg.title: gdfaler / Contribution calendar
svg.desc: GitHub GraphQL contribution calendar. A front-facing calendar grid with raised 3D columns, one position per day. Week columns run horizontally from left to right. Seven labelled weekday rows run vertically, Sunday to Saturday. Month brackets align with the week containing each month's first included date; boundary weeks can contain days from both months. Zero days are flat outlined markers. Nonzero column height is logarithmic in the real count; top-face color follows the five GitHub activity levels. No decorative terrain or simulated data.
